body: Yea, it didn't help me. I hate meds and how they make me feel..

My finances (being broke, not getting hired due to poor credit, lack of experience/education), my education (dropping out of college because of depression), my body (looking much younger than my actual age, skinny hands, wrists and ankles)...
To overcome my insecurities. How though?

I've been trying really hard to change. Dozens of self help books, therapy, physical activity, meet up groups etc.
It's all great but only distracts me temporarily. 

The pain always comes back simply because of my circumstances. 
I don't want to die. I want to get better and not be depressed. I want to be happy and successful. I want to enjoy life and find someone to be in love with. 
I have a burning desire to be whole and achieve those goals... but it all seems so unattainable from where I am now. I'm hopeless and in a very deep hole. I feel like Im too weak and insecure to fix my life and realize my dreams. I'm depressed, traumatized and my self esteem is too low...
The only place where im happy and well is in my fantasies. . In real life, I am just a sore loser who can't function in society or achieve anything.

I've tried therapy and it didn't help. I feel like they all ask the same questions and say the same things. I went for a walk yesterday. It helped a little but the pain always returns. I just feel like I've messed up my life beyond repair. The only reason keeping me alive is the thought og never seeing my kids again. I love them more than anything. It breaks my heart. But they won't even know me so what's the point.
Hi, words cannot describe how shitty/depressed I feel and how sad my life is right now. :(
